description: Seeded planned rows can accumulate duplicates across runs (SKU+Warehouse+Variant) unless the manual dedupe helper is invoked; snapshot rebuild followed by seed may reintroduce legacy duplicates.
impact: Multiple planned rows per key inflate planning totals and can confuse operators before shipment IDs are assigned.
fix_outline: Run or embed seeded-row dedupe keyed by SKU+Warehouse+Variant (with seeded tag) after seeding/snapshot rebuild; skip re-appending if key already exists.
tests: Seed twice from the same Inventory_UAE snapshot; expect no new planned rows.
Create duplicate seeded rows, run the dedupe helper; verify only earliest row remains.

description: Queue sync scans the full Shipments_UAE_EG sheet and ledger every run; on large data sets it risks exceeding trigger time and partial posting.
impact: Timeouts can leave Qty Synced stale and ledger under-posted; repeated runs may reprocess partial batches.
fix_outline: Batch or window processing (e.g., limited rows per run), cache ledger Txn/Source IDs once, and pre-filter rows by delta/status to reduce work.
tests: Simulate 10k shipment rows with deltas; ensure sync completes within trigger window.
Repeat sync to confirm idempotent postings (no new Txn IDs).

description: Function throws when optional headers (ETA/Total/Customs/Other) are missing, blocking status rebuilds in partially configured sheets.
impact: Menu/queue actions fail hard on layout drift, stopping downstream syncs.
fix_outline: Relax required set to minimal status/cost columns; guard writes per column and log a single warning instead of throwing.
tests: Remove an optional header (e.g., Total Cost) and run the function; expect no throw and status still computed.

description: If QC lacks Purchases Line ID or Purchases lacks warehouse, the row is skipped silently except for a generic rate-limited missing-warehouse log; no per-row tag for missing Purchases linkage.
impact: QC rows can remain unsynced without clear row-level feedback, leading to under-posted inventory.
fix_outline: Add per-row tag/note when Purchases Line ID or warehouse cannot be resolved; rate-limit by row key; continue token-safe notes.
tests: QC row missing Purchases Line ID: expect tagged note and no ledger posting; rerun does not duplicate tags.
QC row with warehouse only in Purchases: expect fallback to Purchases warehouse.

description: On every edit the handler builds the full header map before checking edited columns; acceptable for small sheets but can be optimized.
impact: Unnecessary overhead on large paste operations; minor latency in onEdit.
fix_outline: Early-check edited column range against cached header map or cache map once per event in the dispatcher.
tests: Paste a large block into Shipments_CN_UAE and measure onEdit duration before/after optimization.

symptom: Runtime crash on Shipments_UAE_EG edits: ReferenceError colArrival is not defined; totals/status not updated.
rootCause: Variable mismatch: colArr is declared for arrival column but colArrival is referenced.
fixIntent: Use the declared arrival column variable consistently (colArr) when reading arrival values; ensure row updater never throws.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing any recalc column (Qty/Ship Cost/Customs/Other/Ship Date/ETA/Arrival) does not throw.
Status transitions to Arrived EG when Arrival is present and to In Transit/Delayed otherwise.
edgeCases: Arrival cell contains string date not Date object
ETA blank but Ship Date present
Headers missing: function should no-op without throwing
tests: Edit a Shipments_UAE_EG row's 'Actual Arrival (EG)' cell -> expected: no error, Status becomes 'Arrived EG'.
Edit 'Qty' and 'Ship Cost' -> expected: Total Cost recalculates and is formatted; no error.
Remove Arrival value -> expected: Status becomes 'In Transit' or 'Planned' depending on Ship Date.

symptom: Deploy-blocker if real: syntax/parse error (incomplete if/else) prevents script from running or passing syntax checks.
rootCause: The provided excerpt shows an incomplete branch: `if (interactive && typeof safeAlert_ === 'function')      else` which is invalid JavaScript.
fixIntent: Ensure empty-sheet branch contains valid statements (alert/log then return).
acceptanceCriteria: npm run check:syntax passes
Function returns cleanly when the sheet has no data rows
edgeCases: This may be a summarization artifact; verify in the actual file content at the indicated location before acting.
tests: Run npm run check:syntax -> expected: pass.
Run updateShipmentsUaeEgStatusAndTotals on an empty Shipments_UAE_EG sheet -> expected: returns without exception.

symptom: If real: inventory lookup/basis computations can be incorrect (wrong SKU matched, wrong cost basis, wrong stock warnings).
rootCause: Multiple guard lines appear as `if (cond)` with no visible `continue/return`. If this is real code (not excerpt truncation), loop control is broken.
fixIntent: Ensure all guard checks that are intended to skip rows actually `continue` the loop; do not conditionally execute the next statement as the only body.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory lookup returns matching SKU rows only.
Basis builder only includes UAE warehouses and only for rows with qty movement.
edgeCases: This finding is a hypothesis due to excerpt truncation; verify the presence of `continue;` in the actual file.
tests: Lookup SKU that exists in Inventory_UAE in multiple warehouses -> expected: returns correct warehouse match when hint provided.
Lookup SKU that does not exist -> expected: returns null.
Build UAE basis with mixed ledger rows -> expected: only UAE warehouses included.

symptom: Wrong Egypt warehouse posted (e.g., TAN-GH/TAN), splitting EG inventory and violating canonical requirement EG-TAN only.
rootCause: Legacy EG warehouse codes are referenced by comments and prior hardening patch context; destination warehouse likely not forced to EG-TAN.
fixIntent: Force all SHIP_UAE_EG IN postings to warehouse exactly 'EG-TAN' after normalization, regardless of legacy aliases.
acceptanceCriteria: All ledger rows with SourceType=SHIP_UAE_EG and Type=IN have Warehouse exactly 'EG-TAN'.
Inventory_EG snapshot shows stock under EG-TAN only after rebuild.
edgeCases: Existing legacy ledger rows remain with old warehouse labels; rebuild should normalize output buckets
Shipments rows with blank warehouse UAE should not post until resolved
tests: Create a ready Shipments_UAE_EG row (Qty>QtySynced, ShipDate+Arrival set) -> run sync -> expected: IN warehouse = EG-TAN.
Rerun sync -> expected: 0 new ledger rows (idempotent).
Rebuild Inventory_EG snapshot -> expected: only EG-TAN bucket is used.

symptom: Repeated queue churn: rows with Qty>QtySynced but missing ShipDate/Arrival/Warehouse keep re-flagging and re-skipping every minute; ErrorLog noise and wasted runtime.
rootCause: AppCore auto-detect flags based on delta only, while ShipmentsCore sync gates on readiness fields; no persistent 'blocked' marker or readiness-aware flagging.
fixIntent: Align detection with readiness or add stable row-level markers and rate-limited ErrorLog entries to prevent repeated processing of incomplete rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Incomplete rows do not cause repeated per-minute ErrorLog spam.
Queue does not repeatedly run heavy sync for permanently incomplete rows.
edgeCases: Status says Arrived but Arrival date missing
Qty increases after being blocked: row should be reconsidered once prerequisites are met
tests: Create a row with Qty>QtySynced and missing Arrival -> run queue twice -> expected: at most one logged warning per rate window and row is tagged once.
Fill Arrival and rerun -> expected: posts once, QtySynced advances, tag cleared per policy.
Rerun again -> expected: 0 new ledger rows.

symptom: Planned/seeded row duplication across variants and repeated seed cycles; operators see multiple planned rows per SKU/WH/variant.
rootCause: Seed identity key is SKU||WH only; variant is ignored even though Variant column exists in the layout.
fixIntent: Include Variant (and any other discriminator used in Shipments_UAE_EG) in the key; ensure seeding is idempotent and does not create additional planned duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: After seeding, there is at most one planned row (blank Shipment ID) per SKU+Variant+Warehouse.
Seeding twice produces no additional rows.
edgeCases: Legacy duplicates already exist: seeding must not create more; dedupe policy must be deterministic
Warehouse aliases must be normalized before keying
tests: Create two Inventory_UAE rows with same SKU but different Variant and same WH -> seed -> expected: two distinct planned rows.
Seed twice -> expected: second run makes no new rows.
If duplicates exist in Shipments_UAE_EG already -> seed -> expected: does not multiply duplicates.

symptom: Disallowed UAE warehouse code (UAE-DXB) can be written into Shipments_UAE_EG and used as source warehouse hint, conflicting with required canonical set (KOR/ATTIA).
rootCause: Resolver defaults to UAE-DXB for unknown/blank courier.
fixIntent: Change resolver policy to avoid emitting UAE-DXB (blank/unknown or map only to KOR/ATTIA); ensure normalization enforces allowed set at ledger boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: No path in ShipmentsCore writes UAE-DXB into Shipments_UAE_EG warehouse fields if policy disallows it.
Ledger postings only use canonical UAE warehouses.
edgeCases: Courier cell blank
Courier contains Arabic variants
Warehouse already filled manually: resolver should not overwrite
tests: Set Courier to unknown value, leave Warehouse blank, edit SKU -> expected: Warehouse remains blank or becomes KOR/ATTIA only.
Set Warehouse manually then edit SKU -> expected: Warehouse not overwritten.

symptom: Performance risk: full-sheet reads/writes + full ledger scans each run; timeouts and lock contention in 1-minute queue.
rootCause: No row windowing; writes back entire Shipments range even when only a few rows change.
fixIntent: Implement row windowing and write only changed rows/columns; reuse a single ledger read per run to derive basis/baseline/dedupe sets.
acceptanceCriteria: Idle run (no deltas) completes quickly without full writeback.
Large sheet (10k rows) can be processed across multiple queue ticks without timeout.
edgeCases: Partial progress across runs must remain idempotent
Lock release on early exit must be guaranteed
tests: With 10k Shipments_UAE_EG rows and only 1 ready delta -> run sync -> expected: completes under time budget.
Run sync again -> expected: no new ledger rows.
Simulate repeated queue ticks -> expected: progress continues without reprocessing already-synced rows.

symptom: Slow seeding due to per-row update loop; increased chance of timeouts.
rootCause: Uses per-row `getRange(...).setValues([row])` for updated planning rows.
fixIntent: Batch updates into contiguous segments and reduce calls to Spreadsheet service.
acceptanceCriteria: Seeding completes within execution limits for large Inventory_UAE snapshots.
No behavior change: still idempotent.
edgeCases: Non-contiguous planned rows require segmented batching
tests: Seed with 2000 inventory rows -> expected: completes without timeout.
Seed twice -> expected: no new rows added.

symptom: Slow rebuild for large CN shipments due to per-row full-row writes.
rootCause: Row helper reads and writes full row for every iteration; rebuild loops over rows.
fixIntent: Rebuild in bulk: compute arrays and write only computed columns (Status/Total).
acceptanceCriteria: Rebuild time scales linearly with rows but stays within manual execution window for typical sizes.
edgeCases: Rows with empty Shipment ID must be cleared for Status/Total
tests: Run rebuild on 2000-row Shipments_CN_UAE -> expected: completes without timeout; correct statuses.

symptom: Queue runtime grows with ledger size because QC sync scans full ledger to determine already-synced rows.
rootCause: Ledger scan is performed every run without caching/pointering.
fixIntent: Rely on stable Source IDs and ledger-side deterministic Txn ID dedupe; optionally track last processed QC row/id pointer in DocumentProperties.
acceptanceCriteria: QC sync rerun adds 0 new ledger rows (idempotent).
QC sync runtime remains reasonable as ledger grows.
edgeCases: Legacy rows deduped by notes row number must be handled deterministically
tests: Run QC sync twice for same QC rows -> expected: second run appends 0.
With large ledger (50k rows) and no new QC -> expected: returns quickly.

symptom: Operator noise: inconsistent rate limiting and missing row-level tags cause repeated confusion and possible ErrorLog spam on incomplete rows.
rootCause: Baseline mismatch has a global rate limit key, but missing readiness/warehouse tags and per-row rate-limit signatures are not consistently enforced.
fixIntent: Standardize rate-limit keys (versioned, per-row stable signature) and token-safe row notes/tags for missing prereqs; avoid per-minute identical errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated queue ticks do not generate repeated identical ErrorLog entries for the same row.
Rows missing prerequisites are visibly marked on the row itself exactly once.
edgeCases: Row moved/sorted: tag remains with the row; identity must not depend on row number
Multiple prerequisites missing: tags should be additive and token-safe
tests: Create shipments row with missing Arrival and Qty>QtySynced -> run queue twice -> expected: 1 ErrorLog per window and row tag present.
Fix the missing field -> expected: tag removed and sync proceeds once.

issues.title: qcOnEdit_ can throw because it doesn't guard all headers required by qc_recalcRows_
issues.symptom: Editing QC_UAE driving qty columns can crash trigger with 'qc_recalcRows_: Missing QC_UAE columns ...'.
issues.rootCause: qcOnEdit_ checks only Ordered/Received/Defective, but qc_recalcRows_ requires Missing/OK too and throws if absent.
repro: Rename/remove 'Qty Missing' or 'Qty OK' header in QC_UAE.
Edit 'Qty Received' in a data row.
Observe trigger error / ErrorLog entry.
fixDirection: Make qcOnEdit_ guard the full required column set (Ordered/Received/Defective/Missing/OK) before calling qc_recalcRows_.
Alternatively, make qc_recalcRows_ non-throwing in trigger contexts (log + return) to preserve trigger safety.
risks: Trigger instability; interrupts workflow and increases ErrorLog noise.
Users may think QC computed fields are updating when they are not.

issues.title: QC ledger dedupe/identity can be row-number based (QC_ROW_<row>) causing duplicates when rows move
issues.symptom: Duplicate QC_UAE ledger postings possible if QC ID is blank and row order changes (insert/sort).
issues.rootCause: Fallback QC identity uses sheet row number ('QC_ROW_<sheetRow>'); legacy dedupe also parses row number from notes, both unstable under row moves.
repro: Create QC_UAE row with blank QC ID and Qty OK > 0.
Run syncQCtoInventory_UAE (posts).
Insert a new row above so the QC row number changes.
Run syncQCtoInventory_UAE again; observe potential second post.
fixDirection: Require a stable QC ID for posting; if missing, skip and tag the row (no ledger write).
Or generate and persist a stable QC ID in QC_UAE before posting.

issues.title: QC postings use txnDate fallback to new Date() (non-deterministic Txn IDs)
issues.symptom: Repeated QC sync runs may generate different txn identifiers/timestamps for the same QC event if QC Date is blank, increasing duplicate risk.
issues.rootCause: txnDate is set as qcDate || new Date() in the txn payload.
repro: Ensure QC Date is blank on a QC row with Qty OK > 0.
Run syncQCtoInventory_UAE twice at different times.
Inspect Inventory_Transactions for multiple QC_UAE IN rows for the same QC row.
fixDirection: Require QC Date for posting, or derive and persist a deterministic date before posting.
Ensure the deterministic Txn ID computation uses only stable inputs.
risks: Duplicate ledger rows if dedupe is not purely sourceId-based.

issues.title: Hypothesis: syncPurchasesToShipmentsCnUae maxSeq detection block may be incomplete (Shipment ID collisions)
issues.symptom: New Shipment IDs may collide with existing ones if maxSeq is not updated correctly.
issues.rootCause: Excerpt shows 'if (n > maxSeq)' without a visible assignment; may be truncation or a real logic omission.
repro: Ensure Shipments_CN_UAE has existing Shipment IDs (e.g., CN-000123).
Run syncPurchasesToShipmentsCnUae.
Observe whether newly created Shipment IDs restart at CN-000001 or collide.
fixDirection: Verify real file content: ensure maxSeq updates when a larger numeric suffix is found.
Add regression test for maxSeq increment behavior.
risks: Broken mapping Purchases→Shipments→QC; downstream gating by Shipment ID becomes unreliable.

issues.title: EG warehouse canonicalization depends on config/normalization; must enforce EG-TAN only at posting boundary
issues.symptom: SHIP_UAE_EG IN postings can land in legacy EG warehouse aliases (e.g., TAN-GH/TAN) if normalization mapping does not collapse to EG-TAN.
issues.rootCause: toWarehouseRaw uses (APP.WAREHOUSES.EG_TAN || APP.WAREHOUSES.TAN_GH) then normalizes; correctness depends on AppCore mappings.
repro: Disable/omit APP.WAREHOUSES.EG_TAN or configure normalization to return TAN-GH.
Run syncShipmentsUaeEgToInventory.
Inspect Inventory_Transactions Warehouse for IN rows.
fixDirection: Force warehouse for SHIP_UAE_EG IN to the literal 'EG-TAN' before ledger write.
Keep normalization for legacy reads but ensure canonical write.
risks: Inventory_EG snapshot splits by warehouse; reporting inconsistency.

issues.title: Readiness gate vs AppCore pending detection can cause repeated queue churn on incomplete rows
issues.symptom: Rows with Qty>QtySynced but missing Ship Date/Arrival are skipped; AppCore continues flagging every minute, wasting runtime and generating recurring warnings.
issues.rootCause: AppCore pending detection flags on delta only; Shipments sync requires deterministic dates and skips otherwise.
repro: Create Shipments_UAE_EG row with Qty>0, Qty Synced=0, missing Actual Arrival (EG).
Wait for queue ticks.
Observe repeated skipped processing/logs.
fixDirection: Make AppCore pending detection readiness-aware OR mark blocked rows and avoid reflagging until prerequisites exist.
Keep rate-limited logs; add row-level tags instead of repeated ErrorLog.
risks: Trigger time budget exhaustion as sheet grows.

issues.title: Extras baseline builder exits early on legacy Source IDs, producing incomplete baseline map
issues.symptom: Extras-per-unit baseline may be missing for many lines, causing landed cost to drift across partial deltas and generating mismatch noise.
issues.rootCause: Inside the per-row loop, code uses 'return' when Source ID is missing or not SUEG|..., aborting the entire function rather than skipping that row.
repro: Ensure ledger has SHIP_UAE_EG rows where Source ID is not prefixed by 'SUEG|'.
Run syncShipmentsUaeEgToInventory (which calls baseline builder).
Observe baseline mismatch behavior and inconsistent extras freezing.
fixDirection: Replace function-level return with per-row skip (continue) and scan all ledger rows deterministically.
Log drift only after full scan (rate-limited).
risks: Incorrect landed costs on EG IN transactions for partial shipments.
Noisy logs that hide real issues.

issues.title: Shipments UAE→EG sync writes back the full sheet range every run (write amplification)
issues.symptom: High runtime/lock contention; higher timeout risk for 1-minute queue.
issues.rootCause: Full-range setValues(shipData) even when only a few rows/columns changed.
repro: Populate Shipments_UAE_EG with thousands of rows, with only one delta row.
Run syncShipmentsUaeEgToInventory.
Observe slow execution / quota pressure.
fixDirection: Write only changed columns (Qty Synced, Line ID, optional fills) and only affected rows, batched into contiguous segments.
risks: Trigger timeouts causing partial progress and repeated retries.
